_comment: The pages of the handwritten class notes that the site actually cites, one
entry per page, so a reader can open the original handwriting in one click
from the place the number is taught. Every id here is built into
data/note_pages.js is generated from this file for the page to load.
Scope is deliberate: the note scans are inputs the repo keeps out (12 MB of
JPEGs, see .gitignore), so only the pages a taught number or figure comes
from are copied in, at web size. Widening the set is a manifest edit plus a
rebuild; tools/check_note_pages.js fails if a cited id has no page, if a
page here is cited nowhere, or if data/note_pages.js is stale.
'backs' is what the page carries, checkable against plan.md section 2.3's
